name: TCN Operator
description_en:
TCN Operator is a hosted contact-centre platform organized around omnichannel communications,compliance/data tools,reporting,workforce engagement,integration/automation and core administration. Its outbound options include predictive calling and a separate preview workflow;recording/search and selected CRM/payment integrations are additional operational scopes to confirm in the customer’s pricing schedule.

For an illustrative campaign,upload an authorized contact list,map its fields,configure eligible agents and voicemail treatment,then launch through the Agent Gateway. A complex case can instead use pre-call preview. Compare actual attempts,dispositions and recordings rather than assuming that an uploaded list reached every person. No account,list import,call,AI estimate,recording query,redaction,payment or export was executed.
description_zh:
TCN Operator是托管联络中心，按全渠道、合规／资料、报表、劳动力、集成／自动化及核心管理组织。外呼包括预测及独立预览流程，录音／查询和所选CRM／支付集成也是需在客户费率表确认的运营范围。

假设活动需上传获准联系人名单、映射字段、配置合资格客服及信箱处理，再经Agent Gateway运行。复杂案例可改用拨号前预览，应比对真实尝试、处置和录音，不能假设上传名单即联系全部人。未执行账户、导入、电话、AI估计、录音查询、脱敏、付款或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Upload/map contacts and route answered campaign calls to logged-in agents,with configurable voicemail behavior.
core_features.explanation_zh: 上传／映射联系人，将活动接听电话路由已登录客服，并配置信箱行为。

core_features.explanation_en: Give agents customer information before an outbound call for more complex service or sales work.
core_features.explanation_zh: 外呼前给客服客户资料，用于较复杂服务或销售。

core_features.explanation_en: Search call recordings by metadata,keywords,agent or date,and download individual recordings.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按元数据、关键词、客服或日期查录音，并下载单份。

core_features.explanation_en: Build a selected Operator portfolio with a quoted usage schedule instead of a published all-in seat amount.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按报价用量表选择Operator组合，不是公开全包座席价。

en: An outbound operations team selecting predictive versus prepared preview calls and managing list data.
A contact-centre supervisor reviewing recordings and actual usage under a short renewable service term.
zh: 选择预测或准备型预览电话并管理名单资料的外呼团队。
按短期续约服务复核录音及真实用量的联络中心主管。
use_cases.basis: Editorial fit,not measured abandonment,compliance,AI accuracy or cost savings.

Recording versus campaign retention.en: Individual recording download is described. General terms separately allow campaign-data deletion within45days of campaign completion;complete bulk export and exact recording retention remain unknown.
Recording versus campaign retention.zh: 描述可下载单份录音，通用条款另允许活动完成后45天内删除活动资料，完整批量导出及录音留存仍未知。

steps.en: Select products,region,rate schedule and recording/export requirements;confirm termination notice and actual trial conditions.
steps.zh: 选择产品、地区、费率表及录音／导出要求，确认终止通知和真实试用条件。

steps.en: Map a permitted contact sample,choose preview/predictive behavior,and define voicemail,consent and no-agent handling.
steps.zh: 映射获准联系人样本，选预览／预测，定义信箱、联系许可及无客服处理。

steps.en: Check saved outcomes,usage charges and recording access;download needed campaign data before the stated deletion window and before account exit.
steps.zh: 核对保存结果、用量费及录音访问，在删除窗口和退出账户前下载所需活动资料。

items.en: No published usable amount,currency or metered-unit schedule was established despite verified pay-per-use conditions.
items.zh: 虽核对按用量条件，未建立可用公开金额、币种或计量单位表。

items.en: No long-term marketing coexists with month-to-month renewal and30day written nonrenewal notice in terms.
items.zh: 无长期合同宣传与条款按月续、提前30天书面不续并存。

items.en: Core recording/unlimited storage marketing does not override the campaign-data deletion/download clause.
items.zh: 核心录音／无限存储宣传不覆盖活动资料删除／下载条款。

items.en: Terms prohibit uploading sensitive identifiers such as card/social-security numbers and require appropriate pause/redaction;redaction is not proof of perfect detection.
items.zh: 条款禁止上传卡号／社会保障号码等敏感标识，并要求适当暂停／脱敏；脱敏不证明完美识别。

items.en: Predictive no-delay and compliance claims were not independently tested;actual pacing,attempt limits and failure handling need a pilot.
items.zh: 预测无延迟及合规主张未经独立测试，实际节奏、次数及失败处理需试跑。

license.notes_zh: 有限非独占、不可转移内部联络中心SaaS访问，厂商拥有软件／源码且禁止反编译；无额外许可费宣传不授开源或转售权。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 价格页称无月最低量、无额外许可、无年度义务，选择按量方案，设置及24小时支持不另收费。条款月结收到即付、按月续提前30天通知，费用除明确／法律例外不退，税、免费号码维持及杂电话费不含每分钟价。真实单位／金额／订单最低量／AI／运营商／存储／连接器费未知；免费试用按钮不建立期限、余额或免费方案。

faq.question_en: Does no-contract pricing allow an immediate no-notice exit?
faq.question_zh: 无合同价格允许不通知立刻退出吗？
faq.answer_en: The public service terms specify month-to-month renewal and at least30dayswritten notice before the current term expires. Actual pricing schedules or negotiated terms must be checked.
faq.answer_zh: 公开条款规定按月续，当前期限结束前至少30天书面通知，需核真实费率表或协商条款。

faq.question_en: Is a searchable recording interface a permanent backup?
faq.question_zh: 可查录音界面就是永久备份吗？
faq.answer_en: No verified permanent retention was established. The terms allow campaign-data deletion within45days after completion and require download in that period;complete recording export/restore was not tested.
faq.answer_zh: 未建立永久留存，条款允许活动结束45天内删除资料并要求在此下载，完整录音导出／恢复未测。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Select the communication mode before importing the list
sections.title_zh: 导入名单前先选通信模式
sections.en:
TCN Operator combines channel handling,workforce,compliance/data tools,reporting,integration and core administration. Predictive dialing describes uploading a list,mapping fields and sending answered calls to logged-in agents through the Agent Gateway. Voicemail treatment can be configured to leave a message or hang up. The separate Preview Dialer is outbound-only and shows contact context before calling,a different choice for complex cases needing preparation.

An illustrative campaign should establish the correct phone/customer mapping,permission to contact,suppression rules and how outcomes are recorded. Test busy,unanswered,machine answer and no available agent rather than adopting the promise that every answer connects immediately. The pre-launch AI estimate is described as feedback on campaign settings,not a verified forecast or a replacement for operational testing. Exact pacing,retry intervals,abandonment calculation and country restrictions were not established.
sections.zh:
TCN Operator结合渠道、劳动力、合规／资料、报表、集成及核心管理。预测拨号描述上传名单、映射字段，再经Agent Gateway将接听电话给已登录客服，可配置答录机留言或挂断。独立Preview Dialer仅用于外呼，拨前显示上下文，适合需准备的复杂案例。

假设活动应明确电话／客户映射、联系许可、屏蔽及结果保存。应测忙线、无人接、答录机及无客服，不能采用每个接听即时连接的保证。上线前AI估计只是对设置的反馈描述，不是已核预测或替代运营测试。具体节奏、重试、弃接算法及国家限制未建立。

sections.title_en: Search and download are useful,retention is a separate question
sections.title_zh: 查询及下载有用，留存是另一问题
sections.en:
TCN describes call recording in the core system,centralized cloud storage,metadata/keyword/agent/date searches,and individual downloads for offline review. Supervisors can use recordings for coaching or dispute review. Redaction is presented as a control,but neither a product label nor an unlimited-storage claim proves that every sensitive fragment is removed or every historical recording remains retrievable.

The service terms separately reserve a right to delete campaign data within45days after a campaign completes and instruct the customer to download within that period. This is not a guaranteed45daypost-termination archive or indefinite retention. Confirm which recordings,metadata and reports fall under the selected schedule,then test a complete export and recovery before depending on the interface as a backup. No recording was played,redacted or downloaded.
sections.zh:
TCN描述核心录音、集中云存储、按元数据／关键词／客服／日期查询，以及单份离线下载，主管可用于培训或争议复核。脱敏是一种控制，产品标签或无限存储主张不证明移除每段敏感资料，或所有历史录音一直可取。

服务条款另保留活动结束45天内删除活动资料的权利，要求客户在期间下载。这不是保证终止后45天档案或无限留存，应确认所选安排覆盖哪些录音、元数据和报表，再测完整导出及恢复。未播放、脱敏或下载录音。

sections.title_en: Integration and compliance tools need the actual data path
sections.title_zh: 集成及合规工具需明确真实资料路径
sections.en:
The Operator overview names native CRM/service integrations and an open API,with payments among its integration categories. These descriptions do not establish field-level access,retries,idempotent writes or that a successful call produced a successful CRM update. Likewise,compliance tools organize consent,lists and review,while the customer remains responsible for lawful communications under the service terms.

The terms specifically say sensitive personal identifiers,such as card or social-security numbers,must not be uploaded or stored and direct customers to use pause recording or redaction where appropriate. An advertised payment workflow should therefore be reviewed against its actual processor and data handling rather than treated as permission to record card details. Check source records,contact permissions,agent roles and the export audience;no financial action or independent compliance audit was performed.
sections.zh:
Operator概述点名CRM／服务集成及开放API，支付列于集成类别，但不建立字段访问、重试、幂等写入，也不证明电话成功就CRM更新成功。合规工具组织许可、名单及复核，服务条款仍要求客户负责合法通信。

条款具体禁止上传／存储卡号、社会保障号码等敏感个人标识，并要求适当暂停录音或脱敏。因此支付流程应按真实处理方及资料路径核对，不能当作录卡资料许可。需查来源记录、联系许可、客服角色及导出受众，未做付款或独立合规审计。

sections.title_en: Pay-per-use does not remove notice and extra charges
sections.title_zh: 按用量不免除通知及额外费用
sections.en:
The pricing page describes selecting only needed solutions,pay-per-use charges,no monthly minimums and no additional licenses to buy as the team grows. It also says setup guidance and24×7support come at no extra cost. No usable rate,ISO currency or complete billable-unit schedule was published in the reviewed pages. A Start Free Trial button does not specify a duration,credits or ongoing free plan.

The January2024service terms instead define a month-to-month agreement,automatic monthly renewal and written termination notice at least30days before expiry. Monthly invoices are due on receipt unless the schedule says otherwise;fees are generally non-refundable with express/legal exceptions. Taxes,toll-number maintenance and miscellaneous telecom charges are outside the per-minute rate. No long-term commitment can therefore coexist with notice and extra-cost obligations. Obtain the actual regional schedule before calculating an all-in monthly cost.
sections.zh:
价格页称只选所需方案、按量付、无月最低量，团队增长无需加购许可，设置指导及24小时支持不另收费。已读页未公开可用费率、ISO币种或完整计量单位；Start Free Trial按钮也没给期限、余额或持续免费。

2024年一月服务条款定义逐月协议、自动月续及至少到期前30天书面终止通知。除费率表另定，月账单收到即付，除明确／法律例外一般不退；税、免费号码维持及杂电话费不含每分钟价。因此无长期承诺仍可有通知及额外成本义务，计算全包月成本前需真实地区费率表。

sections.title_en: No additional license purchase is not source ownership
sections.title_zh: 无需额外购买许可不等于拥有源码
sections.en:
TCN grants limited,nonexclusive,nontransferable remote SaaS access for internal contact-centre operations and retains the software and its source rights. The pricing phrase no licenses is a commercial claim about additional purchases,not an open-source grant or resale permission. Personal credentials may not be shared. On termination,access ends and amounts due accelerate;confidential information is returned or destroyed with specified archival/legal exceptions.

TCN is an editorial candidate for teams able to own campaign preparation,agent availability,sensitive-data handling and regular exports under a quoted usage model. Complete portability,actual recording retention,number exit rights,AI accuracy,processing regions,UI languages and contractual performance commitments remain unverified. Vendor testimonials and regulatory claims were not treated as independent evidence of outcomes or legal compliance.
sections.zh:
TCN授予有限、非独占、不可转移远程SaaS内部联络中心访问，并保留软件和源码权。价格称无需许可是额外购买商业说法，不授开源或转售权，个人凭据不得共享。终止即结束访问、到期款加速应付，机密信息按规定返回或销毁，存在归档／法律例外。

编辑判断适合能按报价用量模型负责活动准备、客服可用性、敏感资料和定期导出的团队。完整可携性、真实录音留存、号码退出权、AI准确率、处理地区、界面语言及合同性能未核。客户评价及监管主张未当独立结果或法律合规证据。
